note: v2493: organ_matrix._same_thing was the fifth local alias map and now delegates to one_name. Adoption was measured behaviour-neutral before it was made - 132 cells agree, 0 differ - which is the only safe way to consolidate a resolver, because a tidy-up that changes one answer changes it silently. The same measurement stopped me forcing one_name onto A1: it can join zero organ-id to lane-name pairs, because an organ CHECK and a LANE are different things rather than two names for one thing. A1 needs the lane scorer, not a resolver.
